correctness.rationale: Independently checked all 36 color/update choices for the local disagreement-potential inequality. Period-summing yields for each edge 2C_e<=U_v+U_w, while each update has at least four successor supports and degree eight forces equality on all edges and exact four supports. If an active vertex neighbors a frozen one, fixed neighbor supports only one third of updates, contrary to equality one half; connectedness forces global activity. Counts U_v multiples of three; integrality excludes edges connecting counts 3 and 6 for periods <=8. Independent exact signature graph enumeration for all nine (p,s) choices gives vertices/edges (3,3),(12,24),(30,120),(60,444),(3,3),(105,1323),(21,42),(168,3360),(84,372), and no K4, contradicting the graph 4-clique. Graph-wide infinite-size conclusion follows from combinatorial reduction plus exhaustive bounded signature search, not finite-size dynamical simulations.
